QuestInfo.name: Freesia Scent
QuestInfo.0: Lana says the rose scent is perfect for the Kid Mannequin's Bunny Suit. Time to let #bLala#k know.
QuestInfo.1: Rush to #bLana#k before the scent fades and ask her which costume this freesia scent would best complement.
QuestInfo.2: #bLana#k said the freesia scent would go best with the Female Mannequin's Wig. Go tell #bLala#k.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 1,500\nCan proceed to the Lavender Scent quest\n

0.message: 상큼한 프리지아향기가 온몸을 감싸는 순간 이상하게 머리가 아프고 발걸음이 무거워 진다. 향기가 사라지기 전에 라나에게 가보자.

0.0: So Lana thinks the rose scent would go best with the Kid Mannequin's Bunny Suit? Okie dokie. Could you ask about the Yellow Perfume next?

yes.0: I've sprayed the Yellow Perfume on you. Rush to #bLana#k before the fresh scent of freesia fades.

no.0: Is the scent embarrassing you? It makes me feel so dreamy...

1.0: Need my help again? \r\n#L0##bYup! Which goes better with this scent? The Female Mannequin's Wig or the Male Mannequin's Fedora?#l\n#k
